chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan man about 28, short black hair and trimmed beard, wearing a brand-new navy blue suit with a white shirt and no tie
chars.FATHER: a Moroccan man about 60 with a short grey beard, wearing a cream-colored djellaba over a brown knit vest and a white knitted taqiya cap
chars.FIANCEE: a Moroccan woman about 26 with long dark wavy hair, wearing an emerald green kaftan with gold embroidery
chars.HERMOM: a Moroccan woman in her 50s wearing a burgundy velvet kaftan and a light pink headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a traditional Moroccan salon with low cushioned sofas and zellige, FATHER abruptly stands up with a stern face during an engagement visit, NARRATOR sits beside him looking up confused, HERMOM on the opposite sofa stares in shock. Bouquet of roses and a chocolate box on the low table.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon: FATHER grabs the bouquet of roses and the chocolate box back from the low table, NARRATOR half-rising from the sofa with an embarrassed, puzzled face.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: FIANCEE stands frozen in the middle of a Moroccan salon, eyes lowered and pale, a silver tea tray and spilled tea glasses on the carpet at her feet.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: HERMOM stands and talks with an upset, pleading gesture toward FATHER, who turns away holding the flowers and chocolate box, in a Moroccan salon doorway.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Evening Moroccan residential street: FATHER walks fast out of a house door holding the bouquet and chocolate box, NARRATOR follows behind him in his new suit, arms open, confused.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Evening Moroccan street next to a parked car: FATHER slaps his own forehead with his palm, eyes closed, regretful and shaken; the bouquet hangs from his other hand.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the passenger seat of a car at night, NARRATOR stares at his phone screen glowing in his hand, worried, waiting for a reply.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Modest Moroccan family living room at night: FATHER sits NARRATOR down on the sofa with a hand on his shoulder, serious face, about to tell him something.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close view in a Moroccan living room at night: FATHER leans forward and speaks gravely, finger raised, while NARRATOR listens with a shocked expression.
